family: separate team score expectations from shared ridge
clock: archived weekly git vintage; actual fit is retrospective; 2026 development-exposed
fit_policy: League-shared direct team score ridge regression, training-only weighted standardization, intercept unpenalized, other standardized coefficients ridge penalty 12. Weight by recency half-life 365.25 days. Two team-perspective observations per game. First season of vintage warms up form. Evaluation-year weights use only completed earlier seasons. Independent calibration weights stop one season earlier, for out-of-fit residuals on the most recent fully completed prior season. Forward weights can use the full 149 completed 2026 games. Identical calibration fits or training matrices keyed by exact input are reused.
calibration: Signed away-minus-home margin support -100..100 and separate team-score-derived total support 0..140. Empirical calibrated distribution is 90% rounded prior-season signed residual shifted by the new point estimate, 10% prior-season empirical observed integer distribution with symmetric Dirichlet 0.10 per category. Clip tails to edge. Point MAE/RMSE evaluate raw regression point estimates. Probability scores use discretized laws. No joint score dependence asserted.
